data_role: 2026 EXPOSED DEVELOPMENT (EVAL 2026-09-07..2026-09-27 has been scored by earlier experiments; no independent TEST exists)
claims: Descriptive calibration of a frozen path on exposed development rows. No fit, tuning, model selection, winner or adoption. Advisory labels only. Sealed/OPE/B1/B2 artifacts are not opened. Statcast-derived pre-pitch context, not the live GUMBO mapper.

definitions.cell: seven-leaf probabilities of the REALIZED pitch type's action cell (the pipeline scores it only when that type is provisionally eligible for the pitcher)
definitions.brier: mean over rows of the sum over 7 leaves of squared error
definitions.ece_top_label_10bin: sum over 10 equal-width bins of |sum(conf - hit)| / n, bin = min(floor(10*conf), 9) (the registered research definition, compare_e_op.ece)
definitions.leaf_ece_10bin: one-vs-rest for one leaf: sum over 10 equal-width bins of |sum(p_leaf - 1[y = leaf])| / n, bin = min(floor(10*p_leaf), 9)
definitions.reliability_table: per leaf, 10 equal-width bins: n, mean predicted, observed frequency, gap
definitions.ci: whole-game bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20261211, statistic = ratio of sampled games' sums to sampled games' pitch count (ECE from summed per-game bin sums), percentile 95%; differences use the same sampled games for both arms

thresholds.monotone_rule: over the populated bins (n >= 1000) of a leaf in bin order, observed frequency must be strictly increasing; fewer than two populated bins = not evaluable
thresholds.basis: fixed before any result of this run was seen; see REGISTRATION.md section 6

design.name: frozen profile, as-of cutoff strictly before EVAL
design.mimics: a service profile frozen 1..21 days before the game date (the committed service profile is frozen at 2026-09-27 for games from 2026-10-10)

baselines_report_only.note: in-sample tables on the same scored rows (favours the tables); fixed across bootstrap draws

advisory.label: CALIBRATION_ACCEPTABLE_FOR_DESCRIPTIVE_DISPLAY
advisory.rule: per design: NOT_ACCEPTABLE if a point estimate (top-label ECE, whiff leaf ECE, ground-ball leaf ECE) exceeds its threshold, or a whiff/ground-ball reliability table is not monotone over populated bins, or its largest populated-bin gap exceeds 0.03; ACCEPTABLE if in addition every CI95 upper bound of the three ECEs is <= its threshold and both checks are evaluable; otherwise BORDERLINE. The overall advisory label is design A's (it mimics the profile that actually exists for serving); design B is reported next to it.
